## History

Richard Keith was the father of David and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith. Prior to his death, he left a will establishing a trust of two thousand dollars for his children, placing the funds under the care of Miss [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) until David and [Dora](../character/dora.md) should come of age or marry. He ultimately passed away from consumption, a fact communicated by a friend in a letter received two weeks after his death.

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_
